# Pixel Puzzle Swap

A simple 4x4 colored-tile swap puzzle. Click two adjacent tiles to swap them. The goal is to make every row a single color. The swap counter tracks your moves, and "Solved!" appears when you win. Press Shuffle to start a new puzzle.

## How to Play

1. Click a tile to select it (it will get a white outline).
2. Click an adjacent tile (up, down, left, or right) to swap the two tiles.
3. Continue swapping until every row contains only one color.
4. The swap counter increases with each successful swap.
5. When solved, "Solved!" is displayed.

## Features

- 4x4 grid of colored tiles
- Click to select and swap adjacent tiles
- Swap counter
- "Solved!" detection
- Shuffle button to reset and generate a new puzzle
- Keyboard accessible: tiles are focusable buttons, use Enter or Space to activate
- Responsive design works from 360px wide
- Offline: no network requests, external assets, or dependencies

## Running

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server required.

## Files

- `index.html` – page structure
- `style.css` – styling
- `script.js` – game logic
- `README.md` – this file
